name: StackCalc SC-6 Elementary Calculator
description: Foundational Tactile Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) Handheld for Grades K–6 classrooms with default 4-stack XYZT display, 4 elementary superpowers, 7 concrete manipulative modes, geometry formulas, prime factorization, and built-in math quiz engine.

hardware.chassis: Impact-resistant dark technical thermoplastics (Elegoo Space Gray PLA / Sunlu Midnight Navy PLA 2.0+) with Light Gray TPU 95A keypad and tool-free sliding dovetail protective cowl
hardware.keyboard: 28 tactile snap-dome keys with 400g actuation force and unmistakable mechanical click
hardware.display: Transflective ST7567A monochrome LCD with ambient daylight readability and zero blue light
hardware.power: 1x CR2032 3V Lithium Coin Cell (entire 9-month school year life)
hardware.pedagogy: Concrete-Representational-Abstract (CRA) math learning with tactile manipulation

registers.last_x: LAST X register stores operand prior to calculation for self-checking inverse arithmetic

superpowers.name: Rhythmic Skip-Counting & Fact Ladders
superpowers.description: Fills all 4 stack levels with the value in X. Repeatedly pressing [+] produces rhythmic fact ladders (e.g. 7, 14, 21, 28) with auditory snap-dome cadence.

superpowers.name: Integer Division with Whole Quotient & Remainder
superpowers.description: Solves long division by loading whole quotient Q into Line X and remainder R into Line Y simultaneously on the 4-line screen.
superpowers.example: 23 [ENTER] 4 [g] [÷R] -> Line X displays 5, Line Y displays 3

superpowers.name: Step-by-Step Fraction Simplification
superpowers.description: Reduces active fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their smallest prime common factor, temporarily flashing the factor.

superpowers.name: Self-Checking Inverse Verification
superpowers.description: Recalls the previous second operand so students can run inverse operations (subtracting to verify addition) without asking teacher.

visual_modes.name: Base-10 Elementary Arithmetic
visual_modes.description: Standard 4-stack XYZT live display for multi-digit whole numbers and decimals.

visual_modes.name: Ten-Frame Studio
visual_modes.description: Visual 2x5 dot grid displaying quantities up to 10 or 20 paired with carry shelf.

visual_modes.name: Number Line Mode
visual_modes.description: Visual linear continuum showing directed hops for addition, subtraction, and skip-counting.

visual_modes.name: Counters / Discrete Objects
visual_modes.description: Displays discrete tactile tokens for subitizing and one-to-one correspondence.

visual_modes.name: Planetary Clock Modulo-60
visual_modes.description: Modulo-60 time arithmetic for hours, minutes, and elapsed time intervals.

visual_modes.name: Polyhedral Dice & Random
visual_modes.description: Simulates 6-sided dice or generates uniform random integers 1 to X.

visual_modes.name: Interactive Quiz Engine
visual_modes.description: Built-in timed arithmetic challenges with automatic scoring and streak tracking across Levels 1 to 6.

number_theory.name: Common Factors
number_theory.output: Lists shared factors of Y and X

number_theory.name: Lowest Common Multiple
number_theory.output: Smallest positive integer divisible by both

operations.description: Lifts numbers up stack elevator; recalls prior operand on [f]; shows full 15-digit precision on [g].
Exchanges Line 1 and Line 2; rolls 4-stack down on [f]; fills stack for skip-counting ladders on [g].
Divides Y by X; returns remainder on [f]; loads quotient in X and remainder in Y on [g].
Displays mixed fraction; toggles improper fraction on [f]; reduces step-by-step showing common factors on [g].
Displays 2x5 dot grid; shows number line with directed jumps on [f]; shows token counters on [g].
Modulo-60 clock arithmetic for hours and minutes; converts between decimal hours and HH.MMSS.
Simulates 6-sided dice rolls; generates uniform random integer in range 1 to X on [f].
Erases active line or error; launches built-in interactive Math Quiz challenge on [f]; enters ultra-low power sleep on [g].
Submits quiz answers; tests numerical inequality comparisons.
Adds Y and X; drops stack; evaluates greater/less than equal comparisons on shifts.
